content.8.2.3 Timing of Intervention: Discussion on isolated tricuspid valve surgery and its timing related to various conditions such as right heart failure post left heart valve surgery. Various studies analyze outcomes of these surgeries over time.
content.Pulmonic Valve Disease: References clinical guidelines related to the management of patients with pulmonic valve disease, including those with congenital heart disease.
content.Mixed Valve Disease: Outlines diagnosis and management of mixed valvular heart disease with references to expertise and outcomes over time.
